design_philosophy: Premium corporate B2B exporter layout combining organic warmth with authoritative Swiss/Awwwards typography. Focus on trust, large typography, expansive negative space, and editorial layouts. The aesthetic must feel like a high-end commodities exporter—immaculate, credible, and global. Color choices bridge the requested agri-green and gold with deep navy text to naturally integrate the client's blue logo.

rules.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-light tracking-tighter text-[#0F172A] leading-tight

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento-style layouts for feature cards. Strict 12-column grid for standard sections. Use p-8 to p-12 for inner card padding.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-none or max rounded-md (2px-6px) for an architectural, corporate feel. No pill-shaped elements except primary CTA buttons.

visual_enhancers.header_glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-[#0F172A]/5 backdrop-saturate-150 transition-all duration-300
visual_enhancers.hero_overlay: bg-black/30 (keeps the image breathing while allowing contrast for white text)
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) over solid background sections to kill digital flatness.

motion.scrolling: Lenis smooth scroll (MANDATORY). Standard browser scrolling is forbidden.
motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line stagger text reveal (using framer-motion). Background slow Ken Burns zoom (scale-110 to scale-100 over 15s).
motion.scroll_triggers: Fade up with slight translateY (y: 40, opacity: 0 -> 1) over 700ms with easeOut.
motion.hover_states: Product cards lift (-translate-y-2). Images inside clip/scale up slightly (scale-105). Buttons smoothly shift color and scale (scale-105).
motion.marquees: Slow, organic editorial drift for the certifications/tagline using react-fast-marquee.

hero_bg.description: Premium sweeping view of green agricultural farm. Represents origin and growth.

global_reach.description: Aerial view of cargo ship for global export context.

product_moringa.description: Green powder in a wooden bowl for Moringa / Green herbs.

product_turmeric.description: Golden/brown powder in glass container for Turmeric.

product_amla.description: Green powder reused with different framing/zoom for Amla.

product_chilli.description: Warm spiced powder in glass jar for Chilli powder.

sections_and_components.header: Sticky with backdrop-blur. Shrink on scroll logic (e.g., py-6 shrinks to py-3). Left: Logo. Center/Right: Links, minimalist Google Translate language switcher. WhatsApp floating button fixed bottom-right.
sections_and_components.hero: 100vh height. Background image covered with bg-black/30. H1 'Connecting Local Harvests to Global Markets'. Subhead. CTA 'Get a Quote' with smooth scroll anchor to contact.
sections_and_components.about: Mission & Vision cards. Asymmetrical layout. High contrast text.
sections_and_components.why_choose_us: 6 cards with Lucide icons (quality, sourcing, qc, pricing, packaging, delivery). Grid: 1 col mobile, 2 col tablet, 3 col desktop. Soft ambient shadow, 1px subtle borders.
sections_and_components.products: 4 spotlight cards. Hovering image scales, card lifts. Add 'Coming soon' minimal badge/text. Elegant serif titles.
sections_and_components.certifications: A slow marquee (react-fast-marquee) showcasing text/placeholders: FSSAI • APEDA • IEC • GST • MSME • ISO. Separated by gold dot or leaf icon.
sections_and_components.global_reach: Parallax section with cargo ship image. Overlay animated stat counters (e.g., 'Countries Served', 'Tons Exported') triggered by IntersectionObserver or Framer Motion whileInView.
sections_and_components.contact: Deep navy (#0B131F) background. Contact form (use Shadcn Input/Select/Textarea). Fields: Full Name, Email, Country (dropdown), Phone, Company, Message. Google map placeholder adjacent.
sections_and_components.footer: Navy background. Contains the 'Scan & Connect' strip with 3 grey placeholder squares for QRs (Instagram, WhatsApp, Facebook). Links, copyright, and logo.

component_instructions_to_main_agent.forms: Use highly customized Shadcn components for inputs. Remove default blue focus rings, replace with gold/green focus rings.
component_instructions_to_main_agent.typography: Do NOT use default Inter for headings. Include Google Fonts 'Playfair Display' and 'Outfit' in index.html or import in CSS.
component_instructions_to_main_agent.animations: Use framer-motion for line reveals and scroll fades. Respect prefers-reduced-motion via standard framer-motion hooks if necessary.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers (use glassmorphism). Do not center-align paragraphs; maintain structural, editorial alignment (left-aligned text blocks). All interactive elements must have a distinct hover state and include data-testid. Build everything in functional React components. Do NOT add dummy characters/emojis for icons. Execute with precision, avoiding the 'generic Vercel' look by leaning into the defined custom typography and spacing.
